correctness.rationale: Substitution of a four-periodic block gives exactly four product-one constraints P_j=x_{j+1}y_jw_{j+3}z_{j+2}=1 with independent logarithmic gradients, leaving dimension 16−4=12. At each such history, all denominators equal one and the log-linearized one-step 20x20 matrix T_p has four cyclic Fourier factors L_q. Their exact factorizations give (λ−1)^3(λ+1)^3(λ²+1)^3(λ²−p)^2(λ²+p)^2; roots are semisimple for p>0,p≠1, so T_p^4 has 12 neutral and eight p² multipliers. Tangent directions equal the neutral fixed-manifold eigenspace; a normal contraction plus summable tangential drift yields local convergence to some periodic manifold point for p<1, and p>1 has eight unstable directions. Independent SymPy block expansion and exact 20x20 specializations p=1/2 and 2 confirmed the two-eigenvalue annihilator, ranks, and all factors. This does not establish global attraction or p=1 dynamics.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks confirm only the sampled sizes and parameter instances; the theorem must rest on the inspected all-parameter proof.
